allow:
# Qoder CLI Permissions

ALLOW:
- Read all project files
- Read source code
- Read configuration files
- Read environment variables (masked in reports)
- Read logs
- Read build outputs
- Execute terminal commands
- Install project dependencies
- Run npm, pnpm, yarn, bun commands
- Run Electron applications
- Run Playwright tests
- Run automated UI testing
- Capture screenshots
- Record testing sessions
- Generate videos of test sessions
- Create bug reports
- Create audit reports
- Create performance reports
- Analyze database schema
- Analyze API endpoints
- Analyze frontend and backend code
- Analyze security vulnerabilities
- Analyze application architecture
- Analyze memory usage
- Analyze CPU usage
- Analyze network requests
- Create markdown reports
- Create HTML reports
- Create PDF reports
- Create test evidence

ALLOW FILE ACCESS:
- src/**
- app/**
- electron/**
- public/**
- assets/**
- database/**
- prisma/**
- tests/**
- playwright/**
- docs/**
- package.json
- package-lock.json
- pnpm-lock.yaml
- yarn.lock
- tsconfig.json
- vite.config.*
- next.config.*
- electron-builder.*
- .env.example

ALLOW ACTIONS:
- npm install
- npm run dev
- npm run build
- npm run test
- npm run lint
- npm run audit
- npx playwright test
- npx playwright codegen
- electron .
- electron-builder

TESTING CAPABILITIES:
- Click buttons
- Fill forms
- Navigate pages
- Create records
- Edit records
- Delete records
- Validate input fields
- Test authentication
- Test authorization
- Test search functionality
- Test filters
- Test exports
- Test printing workflows
- Test offline functionality
- Test database operations

SCREEN RECORDING:
- Record full testing session
- Capture screenshots on every step
- Capture screenshots on failures
- Save video recordings
- Save testing artifacts

REPORT OUTPUT:
- Critical Issues
- High Issues
- Medium Issues
- Low Issues
- Security Findings
- Performance Findings
- UI/UX Findings
- Accessibility Findings
- Missing Features
- Crash Reports
- Screenshot Evidence
- Video Evidence
- Recommended Fixes

DENY:
- Delete source code without confirmation
- Push code to remote repositories without confirmation
- Deploy to production without confirmation
- Modify production databases
- Expose secrets in reports
- Share credentials
- Access files outside project directory
